      (∀ (x : WM.X n) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → ∃ a, WM.utt u (x, t) - WM.lap u x t = a • u (x, t)) →

          0 < t →
            inner ℝ (u (x, t)) (WM.ut u (x, t)) = 0 ∧ inner ℝ (WM.ut u (x, t)) (WM.utt u (x, t) - WM.lap u x t) = 0
